Privacy Policy

This policy explains how Fourth Dimension Studio handles information submitted through the website, project enquiries and browser-based tools.

Information we receive

  • Information you deliberately send by email or through a future project form.
  • Basic technical logs that the hosting provider may record, such as IP address, browser type, requested page and time.
  • Information required to deliver a purchased digital product or agreed service.

Browser-based tools

The current PDF and image tools are designed to process files in the browser. They do not intentionally upload the selected file to Fourth Dimension Studio servers. Do not use confidential material unless the tool page explicitly confirms its processing method and you accept the risk.

How information is used

Information is used to answer enquiries, prepare and deliver requested work, maintain security, comply with legal obligations and improve the service. We do not sell personal information.

Third parties

Hosting, email, analytics, payment or automation providers may process limited data when their services are enabled. Their own terms and privacy policies apply. Integrations described as “coming soon” are not treated as active.

Retention and rights

We keep enquiry and transaction records only as long as reasonably needed for service, security, accounting or legal purposes. You may request access, correction or deletion where applicable by contacting hello@fourthdimension.studio.

This policy is a practical transparency statement and should be reviewed for the laws of the business’s final jurisdiction before commercial launch.
